description: Use for a rule-based risk label on an EVM address before paying it: exact OFAC SDN match, contract or plain account (Base, Ethereum), outgoing transaction count (Base, Ethereum, Arbitrum, Polygon). Returns the exact paid x402 request for your input (GET /wallet/risk, $0.01 per call), with the response schema and an example; call that URL with an x402 or MPP client to get the data. Bad input is refused before any charge. For an ERC-20 token use token_risk; for an OFAC-only check of many addresses use sanctions_screening_batch. With a P0 access key (header Authorization: Bearer p0k_…, buy one at https://x402-bazaar-rank.x402-bazaar-rank-worker.workers.dev/keys/buy?usd=5) this tool makes the paid call itself and returns the data, deducting the listed price.
